deslag.toml has md.allow[0], which exempts a sentence of src/lib.rs from `banned_chars`. It fails: [rust] selects src/lib.rs, and an entry applies only to the files of its own section, so this one belongs in [[rust.allow]]. Tell the human, who moves it.

The quote: "The parser — a dated record."
The reason: "A record keeps its words."

An entry that does not hold may be deleted; that only tightens the check. Never write or change an entry: only a human exempts a sentence. Leave the sentence as it is, and give the human its text and a reason. Rewording a sentence only to get past a lint is no fix.
